senses.gloss: स्पंद् vt. 1Ā (pres. स्पंदते) 1. To quiver, to throb, to palpitate, पस्पंदे तस्य वामाक्षि Bt.xiv.83; 2. to go, to move.With परि-, to tremble.With वि-, to struggle.
स्पंद m. 1. Throbbing, throb; 2. tremor, vibration, motion, राधामुखेंदौ मृदुस्पंदं कंदलिताश्चिरं दधतु वः क्षेमं कटाक्षोर्मयः Git.G.iii.
स्पंदन n. 1. Throbbing, pulsation, palpitation, quivering, नीवीबंधोच्छ्वसनमधरस्पंदनं दोर्विषादः M.M.ii.; 2. the quickening of a child in the womb.
स्पंदित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Throbbed; 2. gone.
स्पंदित (II) n. A pulsation, a throb.
स्पंदित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Throbbed; 2. gone.

स्पर्ध् vi. 1Ā (pres. स्पर्धते) 1. To contend with, to vie with, to emulate, to rival, to be equal with, तान्प्रति मानमुज्झत नृपाः कस्तैस्सह स्पर्धते Bhartr.ii.16; 2. to challenge, to defy, to bid defiance.With प्रति-, to bid defiance.
स्पर्धा f. 1. Emulation, rivalry, e.g. स्वजनविरोधो बलीयसी स्पर्धाः; 2. jealousy, envy; 3. defiance; 4. equality with.
स्पर्धिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Rivalling, emulating, competing, तवाधरस्पर्धिषु विद्रुमेषु R.xiii.13; 2. emulous, envious; 3. proud.
स्पर्धिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Rivalling, emulating, competing, तवाधरस्पर्धिषु विद्रुमेषु R.xiii.13; 2. emulous, envious; 3. proud.
स्पर्श् vt. 10Ā (pres. स्पर्शयते) 1. To take, to take hold of, to touch; 2. to unite, to join; 3. to embrace.
स्पर्ष् vi. 1Ā (pres. स्पर्षते) To become wet or moist.

स्पर्श m. 1. Touching, touch, perception by touch, contact, तव स्पर्शे स्पर्शे मम हि परिमूढेंद्रियगणः Ut.i.; 2. sexual union; 3. collision, conflict, encounter; 4. the quality of tangibility; 5. feeling, sensation; 6. anything which touches or comes in contact; 7. morbid affection or influence, disorder, sickness, fever; 8. air, wind; 9. a consonant of any of the five classes, (कादयो मांताः स्पर्शाः Pan.); 10. contact (in astronomy); 11. presentation, gift, donation; 13. a spy.
स्पर्श-उदय a. having a consonant succeeding, followed by a consonant.
स्पर्श-तन्मात्र n. the subtile element of tangibility.
स्पर्श-मणि m. the philosopher’s stone.
स्पर्श-लज्जा f. name of a sensitive plant.
स्पर्श-वत् a. 1. having tangibility; 2. smooth, soft.
स्पर्श-वेद्य a. apprehended by touch.
स्पर्श-सुख n. pleasure of touch.
स्पर्श-स्नान n. ablution at the ingress of the sun or moon into an eclipse.
स्पर्श-स्पंद, -स्यंद m. a frog.
स्पर्श-स्पंद, -स्यंद m. a frog.
स्पर्शन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Touching, handling; 2. acting upon, affecting.
स्पर्शन (II) m. Air, wind.
स्पर्शन (III) n. 1. Touch, contact; 2. sensation, sense of touch, organ of sense; 3. gift, donation.
स्पर्शन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Touching, handling; 2. acting upon, affecting.
स्पर्शनक n. A term for the skin (in Sāṅkhya phil.).
स्पर्ष्टृ m. A disease.
स्पश् vt. 1U (pres. स्पशति-ते) 1. To obstruct; 2. to touch; 3. to undertake, to perform; 4. to string together; 5. to see, to behold, to perceive clearly, to spy.
स्पश m. 1. A spy, a secret agent, शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतिरपस्पशा Sis.ii.112; 2. war; 3. fighting with a dangerous animal.

स्पष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Evident, clearly perceived, discerned, पात्रीकृतात्मा गुरुसेवनेन स्पष्टाकृतिः पत्ररथेंद्रकेतोः R.xviii.30; 2. true, real; 3. one who sees clearly.(स्पष्टीकृ 1. to make distinct or clear; 2. to explain, to elucidate.)(स्पष्टम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) clearly, distinctly, (2) openly, boldly.)

स्पष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Evident, clearly perceived, discerned, पात्रीकृतात्मा गुरुसेवनेन स्पष्टाकृतिः पत्ररथेंद्रकेतोः R.xviii.30; 2. true, real; 3. one who sees clearly.(स्पष्टीकृ 1. to make distinct or clear; 2. to explain, to elucidate.)(स्पष्टम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) clearly, distinctly, (2) openly, boldly.)
स्पष्ट-गर्भा f. a woman evidently pregnant.
स्पष्ट-प्रतिपत्ति f. clear perception or ascertainment.
स्पष्ट-भाषिन्, -वक्तृ a. plain-spoken, out-spoken.
स्पष्ट-भाषिन्, -वक्तृ a. plain-spoken, out-spoken.
